title: Mechanistic insights into the antidiarrheal action of phlorizin: modulation of TLR4/NF-kappaB, PI3K/AKT, and HIF-1 signalling with antispasmodic and antimicrobial effects.
authors: Kushwah, Ravi; Jain, Smita; Sahu, Meenal; Praisthy Lj, Chinchu; Maurya, Siddharth; Ansari, Taufik; Mansi; Mishra, Ashwini Kumar; Kuznetsov, Aleksey
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物根皮苷的抗腹泻药理机制，涉及蛋白-小分子对接而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法聚焦TF-DNA结合，与本课题无关。
abstract: This study comprehensively evaluated the antidiarrheal potential of phlorizin, a natural dihydrochalcone glycoside abundant in apple peels, using an integrated approach combining network pharmacology, molecular docking, density functional theory (DFT) analyses, antimicrobial assays, and ex vivo spasmolytic evaluations. Network pharmacology identified 52 overlapping targets between phlorizin and diarrhoea-associated genes, significantly enriched in TLR4/NF-kappaB, PI3K/AKT, and HIF-1 signalling pathways, implicating roles in inflammation regulation, epithelial protection, and cellular metabolism. Molecular docking revealed strong binding affinities of phlorizin with key target proteins including PIK3R1 (- 11.8 kcal/mol), SLC2A1/GLUT1 (- 10.3 kcal/mol), NF-kappaB1 (- 6.9 kcal/mol), TLR4 (- 6.6 kcal/mol), and NOS2 (- 6.4 kcal/mol)-stabilized by multiple hydrogen bonds and favourable MMGBSA energies (- 49.14 to - 69.65 kcal/mol). DFT analysis (B3LYP-GD3/6-311G(d,p)) demonstrated notable thermodynamic stability (DeltaE < 4 kcal/mol between conformers), a dipole moment of 10.6 D, and significant charge localisation on hydroxyl oxygens (- 0.55 to - 0.76 e), supporting strong hydrogen bonding and electrostatic interactions within protein binding pockets. Antimicrobial evaluation showed dose-dependent inhibition of Escherichia coli and Bacillus subtilis, with optical density (OD(600)) reductions to 0.23 +/- 0.19 and 0.38 +/- 0.84, respectively, and inhibition zones up to 2.41 +/- 0.26 mm at 1000 microg/mL, confirming moderate antibacterial activity. Ex vivo spasmolytic assays on isolated chicken ileum demonstrated dose-dependent relaxation against acetylcholine- and histamine-induced contractions, achieving 94.44 +/- 0.98% and 90.91 +/- 1.45% relaxation at 10 mg/mL, with EC(50) values of 4.35 +/- 0.96 mg/mL and 5.62 +/- 0.78 mg/mL, respectively. Collectively, these findings highlight phlorizin's multi-target pharmacological profile, combining anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, metabolic, and antispasmodic effects. The integration of computational and experimental results supports phlorizin as a thermodynamically stable, selectively binding, and biologically active phytochemical, offering a promising natural alternative for the management of diarrheal diseases, particularly amid rising antibiotic resistance.
abstract_zh: 本研究采用网络药理学、分子对接、密度泛函理论（DFT）分析、抗菌试验和离体解痉评估相结合的综合方法，全面评价了根皮苷（phlorizin）——一种富含于苹果皮中的天然二氢查尔酮糖苷——的抗腹泻潜力。网络药理学鉴定了根皮苷与腹泻相关基因之间的52个重叠靶点，显著富集于TLR4/NF-kappaB、PI3K/AKT和HIF-1信号通路，提示其在炎症调节、上皮保护和细胞代谢中的作用。分子对接显示根皮苷与关键靶蛋白具有强结合亲和力，包括PIK3R1（-11.8 kcal/mol）、SLC2A1/GLUT1（-10.3 kcal/mol）、NF-kappaB1（-6.9 kcal/mol）、TLR4（-6.6 kcal/mol）和NOS2（-6.4 kcal/mol），并通过多个氢键和有利的MMGBSA能量（-49.14至-69.65 kcal/mol）加以稳定。DFT分析（B3LYP-GD3/6-311G(d,p)）表明其具有显著的热力学稳定性（构象体间DeltaE < 4 kcal/mol）、10.6 D的偶极矩，以及羟基氧上的显著电荷局域化（-0.55至-0.76 e），支持在蛋白结合口袋内的强氢键和静电相互作用。抗菌评估显示对大肠杆菌（Escherichia coli）和枯草芽孢杆菌（Bacillus subtilis）呈剂量依赖性抑制，光密度（OD(600)）分别降至0.23 ± 0.19和0.38 ± 0.84，在1000微克/毫升浓度下抑菌圈达2.41 ± 0.26 mm，确证了中等程度的抗菌活性。离体解痉试验在分离的鸡回肠上显示，对乙酰胆碱和组织胺诱导的收缩呈剂量依赖性松弛，在10 mg/mL浓度下分别实现94.44 ± 0.98%和90.91 ± 1.45%的松弛，EC(50)值分别为4.35 ± 0.96 mg/mL和5.62 ± 0.78 mg/mL。综合来看，这些发现突显了根皮苷的多靶点药理学特征，兼具抗炎、抗菌、代谢和抗痉挛作用。计算与实验结果的整合支持根皮苷作为一种热力学稳定、选择性结合且具有生物活性的植物化学物质，为腹泻疾病的治疗提供了有前景的天然替代方案，尤其是在抗生素耐药性日益上升的背景下。
